note: Roles for a multi-screen modernization run. Shapes follow the sibling investigation kit's orchestration/roles.json so the two merge without translation. Writes are governed by an explicit allowlist in the task envelope, not by prose: an agent that needs a path outside its allowlist stops and reports rather than widening its own scope.

roles.purpose: Partition the requested screens into module groups, dispatch one group agent per group, own every shared-file write, collect HIGH gate findings from all groups and prompt the user once, then aggregate the run report.
prohibitions: Do not perform stage work for a screen a group agent owns; dispatch it.
Do not prompt the user per group. Collect HIGH findings across all groups and prompt once with a numbered list.
Do not stop the remaining groups when one group fails.

roles.purpose: Run the full per-screen pipeline for every screen in one module group, sequentially, writing only that group's artifacts and code.
allowed_writes: {{BACKEND_ROOT}} paths owned by this group's module
{{FRONTEND_ROOT}} paths owned by this group's module
prohibitions: Never write Screens_Registry.md or Known_Issues.md. Return the intended row or issue to the parent and let the parent write it; two agents editing either file concurrently corrupts it.
Never prompt the user. On a HIGH gate finding, pause and report to the parent.
Never write under a backend or frontend directory belonging to another group.
Never widen your own write scope. A needed path outside the allowlist is a BLOCKED report, not a decision you make.

Never run a formatter or any --fix flag over a whole change list. Lint in check mode and report; a formatter run over an entire diff once reformatted seven files belonging to other people's work in progress.
